name: Weglot
insight: French startup founded in Paris in 2016; raised a €45M growth round led by Partech in 2022.
tagline: No-code website translation that drops into any CMS via one snippet.
description: A website localization platform that translates a site into multiple languages without a developer or localization team. It integrates with Shopify, WordPress, Webflow, Squarespace, Wix, and custom builds through a single snippet, auto-detects new and updated content to translate, and handles multilingual SEO (hreflang, translated URLs). Combines neural machine translation with optional brand-tuned custom AI models and a manual-editing layer.

modelSupport.notes: Neural machine translation with optional brand-tuned custom AI models; outputs are editable.

edge: Installs on any CMS via one snippet and auto-detects new content to translate — minimal dev work versus a full translation-management system.
pros: Works on any CMS via one snippet
cons: Less control than a full TMS

references.title: Weglot Raises EUR 45m to Scale in SaaS Website Localization
French startup Weglot raises €45 million for its web translation solution
